entries.text: Hello, everyone. Nice to meet you. My name’s\nTyme, and I will be your math teacher.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_01

entries.text: Sorry to put you all on the spot at the start of\nclass, but let me ask you a quick question—\r\nDo you enjoy numbers, arithmetic, and the like?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_02

entries.text: Yeah!
entries.label: class_b_01_popup_01

entries.text: Sort of.
entries.label: class_b_01_popup_02

entries.text: Errr...
entries.label: class_b_01_popup_03

entries.text: Oh, my. Hahaha. Thank you for your honest\nresponses.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_03

entries.text: Some of you may like numbers, and some may\nnot. I think that makes a wonderful mix.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_04

entries.text:
But no matter your opinion on math, I hope you
find yourselves enjoying our lessons together!\c
I’ll do my best to find a good way to match up
your interests with all types of math lessons![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_05

entries.text: Speaking of which, are you all caught up on your\nstudies of Pokémon type matchups?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_06

entries.text: For example, Grass is strong against Water, and\nWater is strong against Fire, correct?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], you seem to
be
good
with
Pokémon,
so
let
me
ask
you this...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_08

entries.text: Bearing in mind that Water is strong against Fire...\nIf the move Water Gun hits a Fire-type Pokémon,\r\nwhat becomes of the move’s damage?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_09

entries.text: It’s cut in half
entries.label: class_b_01_select_01

entries.text: It doesn’t change
entries.label: class_b_01_select_02

entries.text: It’s doubled
entries.label: class_b_01_select_03

entries.text: Oh, my. A little reverse thinking, I see! But I’d\nprobably be in rough shape afterward if I got hit\r\nby something I was weak to. Wouldn’t you be?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_answer_01

entries.text: A real hardy individual, I see! But I’d probably\nbe in rough shape afterward if I got hit by\r\nsomething I was weak to. Wouldn’t you be?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_answer_02

entries.text: That’s right! I knew I could count on you for this\nquestion, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_answer_03

entries.text: Using moves of a type that your opponent is\nweak to is a supereffective tactic!\c\nIt multiplies the damage of those moves by two![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_10

entries.text: On the other hand, using moves of a type that\nyour opponent is resistant to isn’t very effective.\r\nIt divides the damage of your moves by two.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_11

entries.text: Haha! I don’t mean to encroach on Ms. Dendra’s\nbattle studies territory, of course, but I thought\r\nit best to use a lively topic as an example.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_12

entries.text: That can make math fun even for those of you\nwho don’t much like the subject, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_13

entries.text: Oh, my. Is that the bell? I suppose that’s all for\nnow. What a shame...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_14

entries.text: I’m looking forward to seeing you all in the next\nclass. I hope you’re looking forward to it, too![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: class_b_01_math_15
